reason: Storage senders on a supervisor Core (#1112). The API worker authenticates POST /api/v1/storage/test, /events and /inventory with the source token on explicit routes matched on the decoded path, validates every body before saving (422 without echoing input), answers /test itself and saves reports as storage.report/v1 commands for the source's project under a principal bound to the token digest; delivery confines that principal to the report paths and revalidates it on replay; authentication refuses it on operator routes; an interrupted report fails retryably; handoff and API promotion fence pending reports. test_api_worker (sender routes, path spellings, undecodable bodies, capacity, retries, release gate), test_runtime_principal, test_storage_integrations, test_storage_sender and test_storage_report_compatibility hold the regression tests; test_runtime_delivery, test_runtime_coordination, test_runtime_routing, test_deployment_lifecycle, test_chat_acceptance_compatibility, test_authentication_api, test_api_worker_composition, test_runtime_global_api and test_runtime_work_batches cover the delivery, claim, routing, deployment-fence, authentication and response-view paths these changes touch. test_runtime_coordination and test_api_worker_composition also make CI provision PostgreSQL.
exclusions: No UI or native code changed. test_runtime_worker_features.py is excluded: it spawns real worker processes; a scratch supervisor Core on PostgreSQL started API and execution workers from a release declaring storage.report/v1 and ran the sender journey instead. Playwright area storage-integrations is excluded: real-core.spec.ts is not run on main and its provider fixture cannot finish turns on this host; the same journey was run with curl against the scratch supervisor Core. All unrelated tests excluded.
